description: This file implements a logging system for the Notesnook project, including database schema, migration, log writing, rotation, retrieval, and initialization functions.

classes.name: NNLogsMigrationProvider
classes.description: Provides database migration for log storage schema.

classes.name: DatabaseLogReporter
classes.description: Handles logging messages to the database.

classes.name: DatabaseLogWriter
classes.description: Manages log message queue, flushing, and rotation.

classes.name: DatabaseLogManager
classes.description: Provides log retrieval, clearing, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: getMigrations
methods.description: Returns migration scripts for creating log table and index.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a log message to the database.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a log message to the internal queue with date formatting.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Inserts queued log messages into the database in chunks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves logs grouped by date, sorted descending.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all logs from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes logs for a specific date.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the logging system with database and reporters.
